title: Ai2
summary: A tabular data science project that trains a loan-status classifier and augments its minority class using synthetic rows generated by SDV. The script 04_generate_synthetic_data.py imports SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE) directly and runs them to oversample the minority class for class-imbalance correction.
